messages:
Noah (Content): Quick sync 1: need 4 assets for next launch: blog hero, slide hero, 2 stat cards for social. Bench charts: cost-per-1k-tokens sparkline, small latency distribution chart, and a micro 'how-it-works' schematic. Add two headline variants. Can we keep a legal footnote?

Priya (Design): Got it. Which color palette for each? v2 default or the high-contrast alt? Also confirm sizes: blog hero (1200x675), slide (1600x900), social card (1200x627) and carousel (1080x1080)?

Noah (Content): Yes sizes confirmed. Blog = v2 default, social = high-contrast alt. Carousel use neutral graphite background. Headline variants: "Production inference at cloud scale" + "Serve faster, ship cheaper." Subheads provided in the doc.

Marco (Creative Ops): Localization needs: editable text layers, a copy-safe area (20% inside margin), and a CSV mapping keys -> copy for translation. Also request a placeholder for RTL adjustments.

Priya (Design): Will supply Figma with frames + a NOTES frame listing data sources and copy keys. Exports: .fig, .svg, .png@2x. Naming conv: launch_bench_blog_v1, launch_bench_slide_v1, launch_stat_card_a_v1, launch_stat_card_b_v1.

Lena (Legal): Quick guidance: avoid unqualified absolutes. If you state "60% lower", add footnote: "based on internal Q4 conversational eval; results may vary" or use "up to 60%". Need the raw eval snapshot to review claims.

Noah (Content): Uploading eval summary now: https://storage.redwood.ai/marketing/eval_q4_snapshot.csv. It contains sample prompts, throughput, tail latency, and per-token cost calc.

Priya (Design): First-pass mockups in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/launch-bench. Added micro-variant text fields for copy A/B (absolute vs "up to"). Also added annotation layer for data sources.

FigmaBot: export complete: https://storage.redwood.ai/marketing/launch_assets_pass1.zip (9.8MB) :white_check_mark:

Marco (Creative Ops): Nice. I'll open a localization ticket and attach the CSV + fig exports. Target copy-freeze: Friday 10:00am PT.

Lena (Legal): I reviewed the CSV. One note: the per-token cost calc needs a short methodology line in the NOTES frame so we can sign off. Add a screenshot of the eval script output if possible.

Noah (Content): Will add methodology blurb and attach eval-script.log. Priya, please include an extra small text box in NOTES for legal copy.

Priya (Design): Done 1 added methodology blurb and small screenshot frame. Exporting updated zip now.

FigmaBot: updated export: https://storage.redwood.ai/marketing/launch_assets_pass1b.zip (10.2MB) :eyes:

Noah (Content): Timeline reminder: finals due Monday 09:00am PT. Priya — can you confirm final export formats?

Priya (Design): Confirmed. Final deliverables: .fig (source), .svg (diagrams), .png@2x (hero sizes), flattened JPG for the CMS, and a text-only editable file for localization. I'll also include an annotations.txt in the NOTES frame with data source links.

Noah (Content): Perfect. Thanks team :rocket:
